demo.summary: Alpine Linux at a root prompt, in a few seconds, logged in as root (no password). Type a command it doesn't have and it installs it; apk reaches Alpine's package mirror.

countdown.name: Firefox
notes: Firefox takes a while to start in this machine: a minute or more can pass before its window appears.
Chromium is installed too. To open it, type chromium.
To install more software, type sudo pacman -S followed by the package's name. The password is arch.
Websites load slowly on the demo network. For a faster web, attach a connection through tailcat or the helper on your computer instead.

demo.summary: Arch Linux's sway desktop, started as the machine resumes, with a terminal open; Firefox starts a few seconds later (Ctrl+C in the terminal stops it and keeps the terminal). Chromium is installed too, and pacman installs more software. Websites load slowly on the demo network. Logged in as arch, password arch (root's password is root). Arch Linux for 64-bit ARM from https://arch.bens.haus/.

countdown.name: The shader demo
notes: The shader demo takes a while to start in this machine: its window can take a minute to appear.
Firefox and Chromium are installed too. To open one, type firefox or chromium.
To install more software, type sudo pacman -S followed by the package's name. The password is arch.

demo.summary: OpenGL on Arch Linux's sway desktop: a few seconds after it starts, a shader demo opens, drawn by the guest's Mesa through virgl onto your browser's WebGL2. pacman installs more software. Logged in as arch, password arch (root's password is root). Arch Linux for 64-bit ARM from https://arch.bens.haus/.
